question.text: For start-ups and technology companies with negative book value, the Price-to-Book Value (P/BV) multiple has what usage per the chapter?

answer.text: Can still be used after adjustment

explanation.text: The Logic: The chapter explicitly states: 'in start-ups and other technology companies where book value could be negative, this multiple cannot be used.' The Trap: A/B/D are misleading - negative denominator makes the ratio meaningless. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XXI-B, XV test P/BV applicability. Manager's Pro-Tip: For early-stage names in a Cat III growth sub-strategy, lean on EV/Revenue and Rule-of-40 SaaS metrics rather than P/BV - the chapter acknowledges this gap.
